startup_file.tagline: Test-prep coaching chain owned by BYJU'S parent
startup_file.what: Gurugram-based test-prep brand for engineering and medical entrance exams, owned by BYJU'S parent Think & Learn since its 2021 acquisition.
how: Coaching fees: Rs 1,956.2 Cr of Rs 2,040.5 Cr operating revenue in FY26 (about 96%, computed).
Franchisee revenue: Rs 84.4 Cr, up 4% (about 4%, computed).
startup_file.watch: The smaller loss came from one-off accounting gains, not from the business growing: revenue is flat. Ownership is entangled in the BYJU'S group's disputes: Byju Raveendran proposed relinquishing his claimed interest in 17.89 Mn Aakash shares to settle Qatar Holding's arbitration claim of over $235 Mn; lenders (Global TLB lenders via GLAS Trust) are reportedly in advanced talks for a 30% stake valuing Aakash at about $2 Bn.

country.name: United Kingdom
country.pr: Indefinite leave to remain (ILR) is still 5 years for Skilled Workers today (B1 English, Life in the UK test, fee GBP 3,226). The government proposes an 'earned settlement' model with a 10-year baseline, reducible or extendable by contribution, integration and compliance. It is NOT yet in force; the government said it would legislate around autumn 2026. Consultation closed 12 February 2026.
country.citizenship: Citizenship usually follows ILR by about a year (general knowledge). If the 10-year baseline arrives, the total clock could roughly double. The UK allows dual citizenship.
country.pro: English-speaking, no language exam beyond visa English.
country.con: Real chance the settlement clock moves from 5 to 10 years, and the government signalled it may apply to people already in the UK who are not yet settled.
